summary: Examples gather package facts, print them, and check whether a package named foobar is installed and how many versions exist.
questions: How do I check if nginx is installed before doing something?
How do I print all installed packages?
How do I count installed versions of a package?

answer_card.title: package_facts examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.package_facts: {manager: auto}
- ansible.builtin.debug: {var: ansible_facts.packages}
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ ansible_facts.packages['foobar'] | length }} versions installed"
  when: "'foobar' in ansible_facts.packages"
```
